title: VerificationResult
description: L4 contract. The contract that makes orlog a kernel rather than a store. verify(citation, claim, as_of) -> Pass | Fail(reason), run by heimdall, deterministic, grounded outside the memory's own interpretation (e.g. current law, a test suite, a rules engine, a schema). Full scope is required for a pass: the citation must exist, be currently valid as of as_of, and actually support the claim. Runs on every exit path, including cache hits (muninn) and action-gating (skuld) — nothing is trusted without passing through here.

verification_id.description: Unique identifier for this verification run.

assertion_id.description: The assertion this verification was run against.

citation_id.description: The specific citation being checked. An assertion with multiple citations gets one VerificationResult per citation.

claim.description: The claim text being checked against this citation, carried alongside for auditability.

as_of.description: The point in time validity was checked against.

checks.description: The three required scopes of a verification. All three must be true for passed to be true.

exists.description: Does the cited evidence actually exist (e.g. does the event_id resolve, is the source reachable)?

currently_valid.description: Is the citation still valid as of as_of (not superseded, not expired)?

supports_claim.description: Does the cited evidence actually support the specific claim text, not just exist and be valid?

passed.description: True if and only if checks.exists AND checks.currently_valid AND checks.supports_claim are all true.

reason.description: Required (non-null) when passed is false: which check(s) failed and why. Must be null when passed is true.
